name: NYC PolicyScope — Full Newsletter Pipeline
description: Triggered by nanoclaw webhook. Reads content JSON, validates, generates images, renders HTML, saves output.

nodes.name: Webhook: Run Newsletter Pipeline
Validate Content JSON
nodes.notes: Validates content against schemas/newsletter.json before rendering.

nodes.name: Generate Newsletter Image
nodes.notes:
Uses Imagen 2 via Google AI Studio API. Images are raw PNG — no Gemini logo.
Skipped if generate_images is false.

nodes.name: Render HTML Newsletter
nodes.notes:
Runs render_newsletter.py which validates + renders the Jinja2 template.
Output saved to data/output/newsletter_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.html
